title: Absolutely Unique Delicacy
description: Tang Wen seems to have lost her appetite after eating something strange...

mainQuestExcel.title: Absolutely Unique Delicacy
mainQuestExcel.description: Tang Wen seems to have lost her appetite after eating something strange...

dialogs.text: Ah... I'm so hungry... I don't feel good...
What happened?
I-I'm not sure... I just feel quite sluggish.
It was probably last night, when I brought home and ate that gourmet meal you made.
Although that dish was... quite special, but it at least filled my stomach.
I then wanted to have a good night's sleep and work well today, but...
Every time I'm about to fall asleep, the interesting smell of that dish suddenly came back up from the pit of my stomach! It instantly woke me up.
This cycle then continued, and I lay half-asleep until the sun came up...
It's not a big deal if it's just having less sleep. I occasionally have to work overtime in the past...

The main point is what happened today! I thought I would be fine after I got up and ate something, but I didn't expect that even when I ate something, the taste of yesterday's dish still lingers in my mouth...
Is that dish so powerful...
*sigh* I think...only a dish with a unique flavor can wash away that interesting taste...
Dish with a unique flavor? Why don't we go around and ask others if they know of such a dish?
Then we can make one for Miss Tang Wen... Maybe that will solve her problem!
Really? That's great, thank you so much! If-if it's convenient, please head to Ritou and ask...
I remember... Li Xiao, a merchant of Ritou, is very knowledgeable about food, and Qiuyue of the Chuyu Trading Company, she can also be considered as an amateur gourmet!
What's the matter? Ah... Miss Tang Wen.
Loss of appetite... A strange taste in your mouth... Needs a special delicacy to salvage this situation?
She actually met with such a difficulty... That's really quite tricky.
But in my opinion, it doesn't have to be a particularly expensive dish. As long as the taste and flavor is unique, and it packs a punch, that should be enough...
I suggest Jueyun Guoba! It has both a unique crunchy texture and a strong spicy flavor...
It's been more than ten years since I first tasted Jueyun Guoba at Qingce Village, and I still think about it from time to time...
I think if it's Jueyun Guoba, no matter what the problem is, it will be solved.
I forgot what book I read this from, but it said that "People are what they eat." So now that I've eaten something weird, I must've became someone strange...
What is it? Hmm... Miss Tang Wen?
A strange taste in your mouth, loss of appetite, don't really want to eat anything?
Is it really because she ate something strange? You're not mistaken, right?
Why does it sound more like she's just bloated? Hmm, let me think...
Forget it, since there is no way to judge, there is only one dish that I can recommend, and that is — Bamboo Shoot Soup!
The taste is savory, the meat is tender, and the flavor refreshing and appetizing. Most importantly, the soup can help in food digestion. Mmm! I wish I could have some right now.
Believe me, all Tang Wen needs right now is Bamboo Shoot Soup!
I forgot what book I read this from, but it said that "People are what they eat." So now that I've eaten something weird, I must've became someone strange...
Oh no, we got different answers. Both Jueyun Guoba and Bamboo Shoot Soup are special dishes.
What should we do? Paimon's so torn!
What do you think, Paimon?
Huh? You're asking Paimon?
If that's the case... If Paimon were to choose...
Paimon will choose Grilled Tiger Fish!
Grilled Tiger Fish sounds very courageous. If Miss Tang Wen eats this courage, her troubles will be solved, right?
Paimon, you sure know a lot about eating...
Oops, that's why Paimon should let you decide.
Hmm... The Delicious Jueyun Guoba it shall be!
Woohoo! Let's quickly make this dish and bring it to Miss Tang Wen!
Hmm... The Delicious Bamboo Shoot Soup it shall be!
Hmm... The Delicious Grilled Tiger Fish it shall be!
I don't think that's the story behind Tiger Fish...
I forgot what book I read this from, but it said that "People are what they eat." So now that I've eaten something weird, I must've became someone strange...
